khila
(‘addendum’, ‘gap’)
------------------------------------------
Certain sūktas like the Śrīsūkta are often called Ṛgveda-khila. The word ‘khila’ means an empty ground. In a more technical sense, it means a gap to be filled up, an appendix or additional material which does not form a part of the original. The word seems to have become common only by the time of the smṛtis and sūtras like the Manusmṛti (vide 3.232).
